subject.title: Agent confabulates completed actions on Telegram surface — same config works reliably on Claude Code/Codex

question: Should this Telegram/ACP false-completion report become a narrow core source-turn invariant, be routed to existing canonical runtime/delivery issues, or be closed/redirected to ClawHub claim-verification plugin work?
rationale: Current source intentionally separates automatic final delivery, message-tool-only privacy, and plugin hook policy; choosing verification, fallback, diagnostics, or documentation changes product behavior and compatibility for existing channel users.

options.title: Define narrow core invariant
options.body: Require a maintainer-approved diagnostic, retry, or verification outcome for Telegram/ACP visible success claims that imply side effects but lack matching same-turn execution evidence.

options.title: Keep broad verification plugin-owned
options.body: Close or redirect generic success-claim verification to ClawHub/plugin work and only extend core if a concrete plugin API gap is identified.

options.title: Route to existing canonical issues
options.body: Treat #45049, #49876, and #85714 as the remaining core owners for protocol-boundary, unattended-delivery, and missing-message-tool cases, respectively.

recommendation.title: Define narrow core invariant
recommendation.body: Require a maintainer-approved diagnostic, retry, or verification outcome for Telegram/ACP visible success claims that imply side effects but lack matching same-turn execution evidence.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the strongest source-reply policy and plugin-scope decision history for this boundary.
